assert.notes: Browser-native assert subset covering ok, equal, strictEqual, deepStrictEqual, throws, rejects, and assert/strict.

buffer.notes: Browser-native Buffer subset covering allocation, encoding, concat, slicing, copy, and equality.

events.notes: Browser-native EventEmitter subset covering listener order, once, cleanup, and error event behavior.

module.notes: Browser-native module subset covering enableCompileCache, builtinModules, isBuiltin, syncBuiltinESMExports, createRequire stub, and Module resolution helpers used by npm/pnpm/Vite preflight.

os.notes: Browser-safe Linux-shaped OS metadata for package and framework feature detection.

path.notes: POSIX path subset for browser workspace paths.

process.notes: Per-runtime browser process shape covering argv, env, cwd, chdir, nextTick, stdio shape, platform, versions, and release.

stream.notes: Browser-native stream subset covering Readable.from, async iteration, Writable, Transform, PassThrough, pipe, finished, and pipeline.

tty.notes: Non-interactive TTY subset with deterministic false isatty and stream-shaped read/write classes.

url.notes: URL subset backed by browser URL primitives plus fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL, and urlToHttpOptions.

util.notes: Browser-native util subset covering format, inspect, inherits, promisify, callbackify, deprecate, and common util.types probes.
